observations.explanation: Pages 3–6 describe retrieval decisions, passage relevance, support, and usefulness as reflection-token predictions, with the generator trained using a next-token objective and those tokens used in inference.

Page 8 reports SELF-RAG leading among non-proprietary models on all listed tasks and shows gains on factuality (FactScore) and ASQA citation precision/recall against many evaluated baselines. The claim is appropriately limited to several tasks.
Page 11 explicitly acknowledges that outputs can still be not fully supported by their citations.

Page 10 says the human evaluation sampled 50 PopQA and biography examples. That modest sample supports the qualified concern that the evaluation offers limited evidence about broader reliability; appendix examples on page 24 do not remove the sample-size limitation.
